capabilities: Generate continuations from the text before the cursor
Summarize, translate, polish and explain selected text
Show ghost-text completions after a configurable idle delay
Run custom prompts with a {{text}} placeholder
Answer free-form questions in a dialog and insert the reply
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README and settings panel; API usage is billed by the chosen provider; ghost-completion diagnostics are written to ghost-diag.txt in the plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send note text to an LLM for continuation, summarization, translation or rewriting.

relations.evidence: Works with OpenAI-compatible APIs as well as Anthropic Claude's native Messages API.
Anthropic uses the native Messages API (/v1/messages) automatically; no extra configuration is needed.
For local Ollama, any placeholder value works as the API key

requires.name: API key for the chosen LLM provider

summary: AI writing assistant that connects to any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API to continue, summarize, translate, polish and explain text in notes.
